name: What are the advantages of hiring an owner-operated general contractor?

mainEntity.name: What are the advantages of hiring an owner-operated general contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: An owner-operated general contractor works directly on the job site as both the lead craftsman and the primary contact, whereas a large contracting firm typically delegates oversight to a rotating project manager or sales representative. Working with an owner-operator provides direct daily communication, faster responses to on-site adjustments, and hands-on accountability for trade work such as custom framing, tile installation, and finish carpentry. Large firms offer larger administrative support, but smaller firms often provide closer attention to detail at more competitive pricing.
acceptedAnswer.description: An owner-operated contractor provides direct, on-site communication, hands-on craft supervision, and personal accountability throughout your entire remodel.
